_todo_rule: The to-do list (author 2026-10-19: 'make sure all this stuff above makes it onto a to do list that can be executed one by one until complete so nothing is forgotten'). Steps are worked in order; a step is closed only by setting status 'done' with its date and the record that shows it done, which must exist in the repository. plan_md.py --check (in the push gate) refuses a closed step without a record, and refuses any finished or running manifest row whose next step names pending work unless that row is on this plan (a to-do step or an item below). Scenario 4 of the showcase was lost exactly that way: its 'Next' sat in a row marked run.
